name: west-berkshire-growing-movement
subject: Building better places together: West Berkshire

fields.heading: Join the growing movement
fields.body:
You haven't started your investment journey with us yet, but it’s not too late. You can be up and running in minutes, with investments from just £5.

Since 2020, thousands of people from all walks of life have become investors in their places. And it is already starting to have a transformative effect.

fields.quote: “It’s changed how I see the council. It’s not just something in the background — it feels like a partnership.”
fields.name: Citizen investor

fields.body:
In West Berkshire, citizen investors’ loans have funded numerous energy upgrades, including retrofitting LEDs to traffic lights and installing solar panel roofs across six council owned buildings, two schools and a leisure centre.

Loans have also funded greening projects, including tree and hedge row planting to protect over 570 properties from flooding whilst creating habitats for wildlife.

fields.heading: Biodiversity, energy security and flood resilience in West Berkshire

fields.quote: “It's great to see local authorities showing their capacity to undertake practical, ambitious climate change projects… when people see the benefits of climate change action in their own community - e.g. warmer homes/lower fuel bills - they are more likely to call for an increased pace of change towards net zero.”
fields.name: Citizen investor
